title: Creator Privacy and Safety
summary: Creators protect themselves by using stage names, separate emails and phone numbers, removing location data from photos, blurring identifying backgrounds and enabling two-factor authentication. Doxxing is the malicious publishing of someone's private info.
answer_guidance: Explain clearly and simply in the user's language; give steps or examples when the user asks how.
